/founding.title: Alpha Theta Delta - University of Michigan Chapter
/founding.description: The University of Michigan's professional multidisciplinary design fraternity
p: “I started ATD because I wanted to create a community where designers and creatives from diverse backgrounds could build wide-ranging professional skills and make an impact on the world around them. During my first three years, I was constantly inspired by student orgs I joined across technology, music, and marketing, but noticed that a dedicated space for design was missing. In essence, founding ATD in my final year of school was my way of solving for an unmet need at the University of Michigan!”

/recruitment.title: Alpha Theta Delta - University of Michigan Chapter
/recruitment.description: The University of Michigan's professional multidisciplinary design fraternity
p: Members of ATD build upon every aspect of the college experience: professional development, personal growth, philanthropy, and social opportunities. However, one crucial value we emphasize is the ability to find and hone one’s own unique sense of creativity.

Our organization uses design as a catalyst for social change by designing for social good, supporting design education initiatives, and bridging the digital divide. Our members work to cultivate and share unique design skills, build meaningful relationships, and expand each other's worldview. Each of our members demonstrate the highest level of drive, passion, and character.

/epsilon.description: The University of Michigan's professional multidisciplinary design fraternity

/eta.title: Alpha Theta Delta - University of Michigan Chapter
/eta.description: The University of Michigan's professional multidisciplinary design fraternity
p: The Eta Class draws inspiration from the iconic New York City subway system and Massimo Vignelli's designs where every arrival marks a new beginning.

We crafted a design system that echoes the subway's iconic route maps — bold, linear, and purposeful. Just as eta symbolizes arrival in mathematics, we've mapped a unique creative territory where design meets destination.

/iota.title: Alpha Theta Delta - University of Michigan Chapter
/iota.description: The University of Michigan's professional multidisciplinary design fraternity
p: Iota’s meaning, “a small amount,” drives our theme.

We draw inspiration from the smallest building blocks of design — pixels. Just as each pixel contributes to a larger, cohesive whole, every member of the Iota class came together to create something greater than ourselves.

Our visual identity extends this idea into space, where Earth is just a speck among countless stars. Just like how Iota also means the ninth star in a constellation, we are the ninth star in the constellation of ATD classes. Even within this vastness, every pixel, every star, every person, matters.
Though Iota represents something small, together, we show that even the smallest elements can leave a cosmic impact.

/.title: Alpha Theta Delta - University of Michigan Chapter
/.description: The University of Michigan's professional multidisciplinary design fraternity
h6: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts
Penny W. Stamps School of Art & Design
Taubman College of Architecture and Urban Planning
p: Alpha Theta Delta is the world's first professional design fraternity, originally founded on May 6th, 2018 at the University of Washington, Seattle.

The Michigan colony (the second ATD colony to exist) was founded on April 24th, 2021 in Ann Arbor, Michigan amidst the COVID-19 pandemic. Our brotherhood has overcome adversity since the beginning, and through design, we hope to solve difficult challenges that the future brings.
To help every member through their college journey with encouragement from a community that cultivates ambition, success, care, and respect.
Our organization strives to make an impact on the local community and design world, and our members approach every day with the desire to make an impact on the projects and people they interact with.
By cultivating creativity, we innovate and solve problems with our design toolbox that never fails to stop expanding and pushing the envelope.
